apps.name: Word
apps.blurb: Draft, rewrite and summarize long-form documents from a prompt, grounded in files you already have.
apps.detail: Copilot in Word turns a blank page into a working draft. Point it at existing documents, meeting notes or a short brief and it produces structured prose you can edit, then helps you tighten tone, shorten sections, or rewrite passages for a different audience. It can also summarize a long document into the key points and open questions.
scenarios: Draft a project proposal from a meeting recap and last quarter’s status report.
Summarize a 40-page contract into a one-page brief with the obligations called out.
Rewrite a technical section in plain language for an executive audience.

links.label: Draft and add content with Copilot in Word
links.summary: Learn how to start a new draft of Word document using Copilot in Word with the power of AI.

links.label: Word, Excel and PowerPoint Agents
links.summary: Create files with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Agents in Microsoft Copilot.

roadmap.title: Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
roadmap.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

roadmap.title: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
roadmap.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

roadmap.title: See a summary from Copilot of the latest changes and comments in the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint backstage view.
roadmap.description: Use Copilot in the backstage view, accessible from the tile tab or start menu, to see a summary of the latest changes and comments made to your Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files before opening them.

roadmap.title: Overview of recent comments and changes in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
roadmap.description: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word, Excel and PowerPoint files using the Copilot chat pane.

roadmap.title: Copilot can edit your document by default in Word
roadmap.description: The default chat experience with Copilot in Word now allows Copilot to directly edit your document. All changes made by Copilot are fully reviewable and reversible, and users can turn this experience off if needed.

roadmap.title: When using Agent Mode in Word, you will be able to manually select which model to use
roadmap.description: Agent Mode in Word lets you choose from multiple models, giving you flexibility to select the right model for your task.

roadmap.title: [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
roadmap.description: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next steps. Changes to the document are supported with controls in the document canvas to review changes made.

roadmap.title: Update document sections from new sources
roadmap.description: Easily refresh parts of your document using content from other files—without copying and pasting. Copilot keeps your formatting intact while pulling in the latest updates from new sources.

roadmap.title: Recent activity is part of Copilot's dynamic document snapshot in Word
roadmap.description: Select the Activity tab within the Copilot summary at the top of a document for a summary of recent comments and changes. Choose a time window of 3 days, 1 week, or 2 weeks.

roadmap.title: Auto-update document sections from new sources
roadmap.description: Easily refresh parts of your document using content from other files—without copying and pasting. Copilot keeps your formatting intact while pulling in the latest updates from new sources.

roadmap.title: Researcher is in Microsoft Word
roadmap.description: The Researcher agent now has easier entry points on the Word canvas —making it faster to go from idea to polished research report without breaking your flow.

roadmap.title: Copilot surfaces key statistics in the top of a document
roadmap.description: Copilot includes a summary at the top of key statistics from your Word document.

roadmap.title: Easier access to Researcher in Microsoft Word
roadmap.description: The Researcher agent now has easier entry points on the Word canvas —making it faster to go from idea to polished research report without breaking your flow.

roadmap.title: Document snapshot in Word personalizes output
roadmap.description: The document snapshot helps the user focus faster by surfacing the most important information for them based on their personal context.

roadmap.title: Content suggestions in Word
roadmap.description: Select the Suggestions tab within the Copilot summary at the top of a Word document for suggestions on improving the content of the document.

roadmap.title: Current web content included when drafting with Copilot in Word
roadmap.description: Draft with Copilot will include information from Bing search, resulting in content that's as current as what you would find when searching with Bing on the web.

roadmap.title: Drafting on a selection includes being able to reference files, emails, and meetings
roadmap.description: Just like when you're using Copilot to draft content on a blank line in your document, you can reference resources that provide context in addition to the content you've selected in your document.

roadmap.title: Catch up on a summary of document comments in the top of your document
roadmap.description: Copilot will have a Discussion tab in the top of your document to summarize open comments, helping you quickly understand what people have said in comments.

roadmap.title: Drafting on a selection includes being able to reference files, people, emails, and meetings
roadmap.description: Just like when you're using Copilot to draft content on a blank line in your document, you can reference resources that provide context in addition to the content you've selected in your document.

roadmap.title: Reference People from your enterprise in Copilot in Word
roadmap.description: Users can now reference People from your enterprise while generating content in Word.

roadmap.title: Copilot takes emails and meetings into account while drafting content in Word
roadmap.description: You will no longer need to reference certain types of organizational data for Copilot to generate contextually relevant content. People and chats will still need to be referenced explicitly.

roadmap.title: Word Agent
roadmap.description: Word Agent helps you handle research, structure, and formatting so you can stay focused on your ideas. Use multi-turn chat to refine your draft or open it in Word for full editing and collaboration. It’s designed for long-form, information-dense work—like strategic plans, policy documents, and technical papers—making it easier to turn complex material into clear, well-written content. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

roadmap.title: Referenced sources are cited in drafted content
roadmap.description: When drafting content that's based on referenced sources, Copilot includes citations in the text it generates, indicating references to information in the content.

roadmap.title: Support for summarization of very long documents
roadmap.description: Copilot in Word can summarize documents up to about 1,500,000 words or 3,000 pages. This summary will be available on top of the document.

roadmap.title: Fix all spelling and grammar issues with Copilot
roadmap.description: One-click solution to fix spelling and grammar errors in the document

apps.name: Excel
apps.blurb: Analyze data, generate formulas and build charts in natural language, with multi-step reasoning over your workbook.
apps.detail: Copilot in Excel works with your data the way an analyst would. Ask a question in plain language and it will suggest formulas, add calculated columns, highlight trends and outliers, and build the chart or PivotTable that answers it. Agent Mode can carry out multi-step tasks, showing its reasoning so you can check the work before applying it.
scenarios: Identify the key drivers behind this quarter’s forecast variance.
Add a column that flags every order shipped more than five days late.
Summarize this survey export into themes and chart the top responses.

links.label: Get started with Copilot in Excel
links.summary: Use Copilot in Excel to analyze data, generate formulas, create charts, and more.

roadmap.title: Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
roadmap.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

roadmap.title: Excel canvas
roadmap.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

roadmap.title: Summarize text columns with Copilot
roadmap.description: Copilot can analyze columns of text to generate related categories or tags. For example, Copilot will find the main themes in survey responses from open-ended questions.

roadmap.title: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
roadmap.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every change.

roadmap.title: See a summary from Copilot of the latest changes and comments in the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint backstage view.
roadmap.description: Use Copilot in the backstage view, accessible from the tile tab or start menu, to see a summary of the latest changes and comments made to your Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files before opening them.

roadmap.title: Local file support for Agent Mode in Excel
roadmap.description: Extending support for modern Excel workbooks stored on your device to Agent Mode in Excel, giving users the flexibility to use multi-step editing capabilities with Copilot in Excel no matter whether files are stored locally or in the cloud.

roadmap.title: Excel Agent
roadmap.description: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built-in formulas and logic. It streamlines data preparation, formulas, and visualization so you can stay focused on the story behind the numbers. Use multi-turn chat to refine your output or open it in Excel for full editing and collaboration. Ideal for financial forecasts, project plans, and decision-making tools. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

roadmap.title: Formula completion with Copilot in Excel
roadmap.description: This feature leverages AI to autocomplete the user's formula upon typing the '=' sign. It provides context-based suggestions, streamlining the formula creation process by offering intelligent and relevant completions.

blogs.title: Copilot in Excel: Bringing clarity to collaborative workbooks
blogs.description: Spreadsheets rarely stay still. Numbers get updated, formulas change, teammates make edits, and Copilot helps move work forward. But when you come back to a workbook, one question can be surprisingly hard to answer: What changed? Until now, finding out often m

blogs.title: What's New in Excel (August 2026)
blogs.description: Welcome to the August 2026 update. New this month for Copilot, chat history, chart/PivotTable skills, Python skill, as well as change history. Excel for Windows, Mac, and web: - Copilot in Excel: change history skill #FIA - Copilot in Excel: chat history #FIA

blogs.title: Bring your organization’s data into Excel with new Copilot synced connectors
blogs.description: Excel is where people turn data into decisions. But the data you need often lives in other systems, like your engineering backlog, ticketing system, or CRM. Getting that data into Excel usually means exporting files, copying and pasting, or working from CSVs t

blogs.title: What's New in Excel (July 2026)
blogs.description: Welcome to the July 2026 update. New this month for Copilot in Excel: inline citations, synced connectors, Power BI grounding, brand and theme design skills, and support for workbooks with AutoSave turned off. Also new this month, two frontier models are now a

blogs.title: Copilot in Excel: Built for the era of Frontier Finance
blogs.description: Plenty of AI tools claim to be built for finance; Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel is proving it in practice.

apps.name: PowerPoint
apps.blurb: Turn prompts and existing documents into complete presentations, then refine layout, visuals and speaker notes.
apps.detail: Copilot in PowerPoint builds a first-draft deck from a prompt, a Word document or a set of notes — choosing a structure, laying out slides and adding relevant imagery. From there you can ask it to reorganize sections, tighten wording, add speaker notes, or restyle the deck to match your template.
scenarios: Turn this project charter document into a 10-slide kickoff deck.
Add speaker notes to every slide aimed at a non-technical audience.
Condense this 30-slide deck into a five-minute executive summary.

links.label: Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint
links.summary: Learn how to use the power of AI in Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation from scratch.

roadmap.title: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
roadmap.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

roadmap.title: Skills in Brand Kit
roadmap.description: Upload skill (.md file) in Brand Kit and use within PPT Copilot

roadmap.title: Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

roadmap.title: Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

roadmap.title: Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
roadmap.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

roadmap.title: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Web)
roadmap.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

roadmap.title: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
roadmap.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

roadmap.title: Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
roadmap.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

roadmap.title: Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
roadmap.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

roadmap.title: See a summary from Copilot of the latest changes and comments in the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint backstage view.
roadmap.description: Use Copilot in the backstage view, accessible from the tile tab or start menu, to see a summary of the latest changes and comments made to your Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files before opening them.

roadmap.title: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
roadmap.description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Flux, or Auto for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.

roadmap.title: Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
roadmap.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.

apps.name: Outlook
apps.blurb: Summarize long mail threads, draft replies in your voice, and catch up on what changed while you were away.
apps.detail: Copilot in Outlook cuts down inbox time. It summarizes long threads into the decisions and open items, drafts replies you can tune for length and tone, and surfaces the messages that actually need you. Coaching by Copilot reviews a draft before you send it and flags unclear or blunt phrasing.
scenarios: Summarize this 30-message thread and list what still needs a decision.
Draft a reply declining the request but proposing two alternative dates.
Show me what I missed in my inbox while I was out last week.

links.label: Chat with Copilot in Outlook
links.summary: Copilot in Outlook offers fully integrated contextual help, email summarization, and task automation like drafting, auto-replies, and rule creation for Windows and Web.

roadmap.title: Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
roadmap.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

roadmap.title: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
roadmap.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

roadmap.title: Inline chat for email drafting
roadmap.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

roadmap.title: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
roadmap.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

roadmap.title: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
roadmap.description: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

roadmap.title: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
roadmap.description: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.

roadmap.title: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
roadmap.description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

roadmap.title: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
roadmap.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

roadmap.title: View, edit & share Copilot Pages with Outlook for Android
roadmap.description: Users can now view, edit and share Copilot Pages with Outlook for Android, making it easier to continue working with Copilot and colleagues while on the go.

roadmap.title: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
roadmap.description: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.

roadmap.title: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS
roadmap.description: Access Copilot directly when previewing files in Outlook. Tap the Copilot button to get smart suggestions, summaries, and answers about your documents without leaving the previewer. Get quick help understanding attachments and files right when you need it.

roadmap.title: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
roadmap.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

roadmap.title: Triage your inbox on-the-go with Copilot voice for Outlook mobile
roadmap.description: Stay on top of your inbox with the new Copilot voice experience in the Outlook mobile app. Ask Copilot to summarize your recent unread emails and then take action like flagging, pinning, archiving, or marking as read – all without the hassle of navigating your inbox by hand. You can interrupt or redirect Copilot at any point in the conversation.

roadmap.title: Unified Agent and App Availability Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
roadmap.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage agents and apps that work across Teams, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot will be able to apply their changes consistently across all these surfaces. Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, app and agent availability will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 copilot.

roadmap.title: New Scheduling and Event Creation Experience
roadmap.description: The Outlook and Teams calendars will receive an update to the scheduling and event creation experience. Additionally, new capabilities will be available in this new experience to help streamline and enhance scheduling using Copilot. #newoutlookforwindows

roadmap.title: Immersive Search
roadmap.description: After completing a search in Outlook, a user will see a Copilot entry point that will take them to an LLM generated summary of their search query (emails, Teams messages and documents) within their Copilot side pane. They will be able to interact further with Copilot to dig deeper into these results and take action items accordingly.

roadmap.title: Chat for Outlook iOS and Android
roadmap.description: On phone devices, users currently access Copilot Chat in Outlook Mobile via a tab at the bottom of their screen (or in Apps). Outlook is introducing a new Copilot Chat overlay experience, allowing users to chat with Copilot while continuing to interact with their email, calendar, and contacts. This overlay will be context-aware—understanding what the user is viewing—so users can ask Copilot about the content on their screen. Users with M365 Copilot licenses will also benefit from Copilot’s ability to draw on Microsoft 365 Graph to provide richer, more personalized responses.

roadmap.title: Create a meeting from an email thread with Copilot
roadmap.description: Copilot makes it fast and easy to schedule a meeting from an email thread. When you use the Schedule with Copilot option, Copilot analyzes the email and creates a meeting invitation for you, filling in a meeting title and agenda, and adding the email thread as an attachment. The people on the email thread are included as meeting attendees, and you can quickly review the invitation, add or change info, and then send it out.

roadmap.title: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot
roadmap.description: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot marks high priority mails in your inbox and provides a short summary of the mail's importance in the message list and the reading pane. Mails can be sorted and filtered by Copilot's priority. In Web and New Outlook for Windows, you can also choose to have Copilot mark low priority mails. #newoutlookforwindows

apps.name: Teams
apps.blurb: Recap meetings, surface decisions and action items, and catch up on channel and chat activity you missed.
apps.detail: Copilot in Teams turns conversations into something you can act on. During or after a meeting it recaps what was discussed, who said what, which decisions were made and which follow-ups were assigned — whether or not you attended. In chats and channels it summarizes long back-and-forth threads so you can rejoin quickly.
scenarios: Recap the meeting I missed and list the action items assigned to my team.
What questions were raised about the budget, and were they answered?
Summarize the last two weeks of activity in this channel.

links.label: Catch up on meetings with Copilot in Teams
links.summary: Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings helps you capture and share the key points, action items, and outcomes of your online meetings.

roadmap.title: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
roadmap.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

roadmap.title: Express face enrollment
roadmap.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

roadmap.title: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
roadmap.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

roadmap.title: Meeting Shared Files
roadmap.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

roadmap.title: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
roadmap.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

roadmap.title: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
roadmap.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

roadmap.title: Facilitator detects and answers questions
roadmap.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

roadmap.title: Enhanced Copilot chat summary
roadmap.description: Missed many messages? Copilot will automatically generate a summary of the new messages in a chat conversation, so you can catch up quickly without reading every message.

roadmap.title: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
roadmap.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

roadmap.title: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
roadmap.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

roadmap.title: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
roadmap.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

roadmap.title: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
roadmap.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.

roadmap.title: Unified Agent and App Installation Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
roadmap.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Previously, installation changes made in the Microsoft 365 admin center only applied to Outlook and Microsoft 365, while changes made in the Teams admin center only applied to Teams. With this update, app and agent installation is unified across all supported surfaces, enabling a more consistent and streamlined admin experience.

roadmap.title: Multilingual recap available with translation button
roadmap.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

roadmap.title: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
roadmap.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

roadmap.title: Sharing recap access
roadmap.description: Recording and transcript owners can now grant recording and transcript access to specified people when copying or sharing recap link, and the specified people can access the recap without having to request access.

roadmap.title: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
roadmap.description: Users can chat one-on-one with a SharePoint agent directly within Teams chat.

roadmap.title: Delete meeting generated content in recap
roadmap.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

roadmap.title: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
roadmap.description: Consecutive interpretation enables turn-based interpretation for everyone in the meeting. Interpretation happens after each speaker finishes talking, creating a turn-based flow that supports interactive discussions across two languages.

roadmap.title: Spoken language detection is now automatic
roadmap.description: Spoken language detection is now fully automatic. Teams will automatically detect each speaker’s spoken language and update it in real time as the conversation evolves. Manual spoken language selection will no longer be available. This applies to both live captions and transcripts when Interpreter is enabled or when multilingual speech recognition is turned on in meeting options, helping deliver more accurate language recognition and a more consistent multilingual meeting experience.

roadmap.title: Unified Agent and App Availability Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
roadmap.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage agents and apps that work across Teams, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot will be able to apply their changes consistently across all these surfaces. Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, app and agent availability will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 copilot.

roadmap.title: New Scheduling and Event Creation Experience
roadmap.description: The Outlook and Teams calendars will receive an update to the scheduling and event creation experience. Additionally, new capabilities will be available in this new experience to help streamline and enhance scheduling using Copilot. #newoutlookforwindows

roadmap.title: Simplified device settings for voice and face recognition on Teams Rooms on Android
roadmap.description: It's easier for admins to enable the benefits of intelligent audio and video and Copilot for users in Teams Rooms through a new user interface and admin settings. These new settings, on the device and in the Pro Management portal, simplify configuration and remove the requirement to use PowerShell, offering improved visibility across rooms.

roadmap.title: Channel Agent
roadmap.description: Channel agent works alongside you and your team to help you manage projects. It can create status reports, send emails, schedule meetings, co-author documents, and answer questions. Channel agent understands context from meetings, chats, and files, and uses that knowledge to help you move work forward. It’s designed to save time, reduce manual effort, and make collaboration more intelligent.

roadmap.title: Speaker attribution now “On” by default in BYOD rooms with enhanced admin controls
roadmap.description: New PowerShell setting (SpeakerAttributionBYOD in csTeamsAIPolicy), enabled by default, gives IT admins more control over speaker attribution in BYOD (bring your own device) meeting rooms. This enhances the experience for users by enabling clear speaker labels and richer in-meeting and post-meeting insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Users just enroll profiles via Teams Settings to be recognized.

blogs.title: Turn conversations into code with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
blogs.description: Coding where context lives and collaboration happens The best prompt may be the conversation your team has already had or is currently having. Until now, using a coding agent often meant paying context and coordination taxes. Developers had to leave the discus

blogs.title: Engage customers with Teams Phone Agent and custom voice agents built in Copilot Studio
blogs.description: It’s often difficult for businesses to serve every customer right away during surges in call volumes. Callers sit on hold while staff race to work through the backlog. Meanwhile, agentic voice AI is opening entirely new ways to serve customers, such as getting

blogs.title: Microsoft Teams Takes Center Stage at the 2026 Microsoft 365 Community Conference
blogs.description: Microsoft Teams is where people, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and agents come together to collaborate, communicate, and get work done—before, during, and after every interaction. Contributing to and benefiting from Work IQ, Copilot in Teams understands the context,

apps.name: OneNote
apps.blurb: Summarize notebooks, pull out action items and turn rough notes into structured plans.
apps.detail: Copilot in OneNote reads across your pages and sections to make sense of accumulated notes. It can summarize a sprawling notebook, extract the to-dos buried in it, and reshape raw meeting scribbles into an organized plan or checklist.
scenarios: Summarize this notebook section and pull out every action item.
Turn these rough interview notes into a structured candidate summary.
Create a checklist from the decisions captured across these pages.

links.label: Summarize your OneNote notes with Copilot
links.summary: Use AI to quickly summarize your OneNote notes with Copilot and share at the click of a button.

roadmap.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
roadmap.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

roadmap.title: Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

roadmap.title: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
roadmap.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

roadmap.title: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
roadmap.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

roadmap.title: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

roadmap.title: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

roadmap.title: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
roadmap.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

roadmap.title: Copilot Notebooks available in OneNote on Web
roadmap.description: Users will now have access to their Copilot Notebooks on the web version of OneNote.

roadmap.title: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

roadmap.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
roadmap.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

roadmap.title: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

apps.name: Loop
apps.blurb: Co-create and refine shared Loop pages and components with Copilot alongside your team.
apps.detail: Copilot in Loop works inside the shared page rather than off to the side, so drafting is a group activity. It can generate a starting page from a prompt, restructure content as thinking evolves, and summarize where a collaborative document has landed — with everyone seeing the same changes in real time.
scenarios: Draft a project brief page the team can edit together.
Summarize where this planning page has landed so far.
Reorganize these scattered notes into a clear set of workstreams.

links.label: Copilot in Loop FAQ
links.summary: Get answers to frequently asked questions about using Copilot in Loop.

apps.name: OneDrive
apps.blurb: Ask questions across your stored files, compare documents and summarize them without opening each one.
apps.detail: Copilot in OneDrive answers questions about your files without making you open them. Select one or several documents and ask for a summary, a comparison, or a specific detail — useful when the answer is spread across versions, contracts or reports you only half remember.
scenarios: Summarize these five documents and tell me how they differ.
Which version of this proposal has the updated pricing?
Find the file where we documented the escalation process.

links.label: Get started with Copilot in OneDrive
links.summary: Learn how to get started with using Copilot and AI to manage files in your OneDrive. Find out different features for Copilot in OneDrive and additional resources on managing the features.

roadmap.title: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
roadmap.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

roadmap.title: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
roadmap.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS.

roadmap.title: Copilot suggested rename
roadmap.description: Copilot Suggested Rename is an AI-powered OneDrive feature that automatically recommends clear, descriptive file names based on a file’s content—helping users organize and find their files more easily with minimal effort. What the feature does: - Analyzes the content of a file to generate context-aware filename suggestions - Presents 3 recommended names directly within the rename dialog - Allows users to pick a suggestion with a single click Where it shows up: - Within the rename dialog for supported files - Within the post-upload toast notification when a single supported file is uploaded Supported file types: - Microsoft Office documents Word (DOCX) PowerPoint (PPTX) Excel (XLSX) - Other document formats PDF Markdown (MD) - Images

roadmap.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot in OneDrive
roadmap.description: We're excited to bring M365 Copilot in OneDrive, a new unified Copilot chat experience designed to make working with your files simpler, smarter, and more seamless across Microsoft 365.

roadmap.title: Convert Copilot response into a Word file
roadmap.description: Like a summary or FAQ that Copilot generated for you? Now, with one click, you can convert any Copilot response into a Word document. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.

roadmap.title: Create a presentation from a Word file
roadmap.description: With Copilot, you can create the first draft of your presentation using a Word file in just a single click. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.

apps.name: SharePoint
apps.blurb: Build sites and pages faster and ground Copilot answers in your organization’s published content.
apps.detail: SharePoint is both a place Copilot helps you build and a source it draws on. Copilot can draft pages and assemble sites from a description, while the content you publish there becomes grounding for answers across Microsoft 365 — so well-maintained sites make every other Copilot surface better.
scenarios: Create a project site with a home page, news section and document library.
Draft a policy page summarizing our updated travel guidelines.
What does our published documentation say about data retention?

links.label: Copilot in SharePoint help & learning
links.summary: Learn how to boost productivity with Copilot in SharePoint. Your AI-powered assistant can help you streamline workflows, enhance collaboration, and simplify content creation.

roadmap.title: Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

roadmap.title: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
roadmap.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

roadmap.title: Structured Document Generation with Forms
roadmap.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

roadmap.title: Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
roadmap.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint. Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields. Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint. This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs. The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.

roadmap.title: Site Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: The feature introduces enhanced Site Skills management capabilities, including skill editing, version control, publishing, restoration, and cross-site duplication, enabling organizations to govern and reuse skills more effectively across SharePoint sites.

roadmap.title: HTML pages
roadmap.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

roadmap.title: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
roadmap.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS.

roadmap.title: Enterprise store plugins in Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: Copilot in SharePoint now supports plugins from your enterprise store. A plugin can bundle skills, MCP servers, and other capabilities that extend what Copilot can do. Any plugin made available to your organization, whether installed tenant-wide by an admin or added by you, works directly in Copilot in SharePoint, all governed by your M365 admin. For example, your organization can publish a company-wide accessibility plugin once and have it work consistently across all agentic products, including Copilot in SharePoint, so everyone gets the same accessible experience wherever they work.

roadmap.title: Personal Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: Create your own personal skills in Copilot in SharePoint and use them anywhere you work. Personal skills travel with you across SharePoint sites and OneDrive—so a skill like document generation works everywhere without recreating it per site. You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.

roadmap.title: Create new workflows with Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: Describe a workflow intent such as "when files are set to status = Complete, post a message in my Teams chat" and Copilot in SharePoint will assemble the necessary triggers, conditions, and actions to setup your workflow. You can come back to Copilot in SharePoint at any time to make changes or click "Workflows" from the command bar to see your live workflow.

roadmap.title: SharePoint agent analytics on Viva Insights
roadmap.description: Explore how your employees used key SharePoint agent features over a given time period and understand the ROI. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Page Agent
roadmap.description: The SharePoint Page Agent is a declarative agent that enables users to create and refine SharePoint pages directly within BizChat or other Copilot apps. It seamlessly integrates SharePoint authoring into everyday conversations, eliminating the need to switch apps or manually open SharePoint. With this feature, users can generate structured content such as meeting recaps, announcements, and project updates, create SharePoint pages instantly from chat.

roadmap.title: Get relevant information from Lists in Knowledge Agent
roadmap.description: Users will be able to find relevant information, matching items and get answers from Microsoft Lists using Knowledge Agent.

roadmap.title: New Microsoft 365 Copilot Skills for SharePoint Administration
roadmap.description: We’re excited to announce two new Copilot skills in the SharePoint Admin Center: 1. Step-by-Step Task Guidance Copilot can now walk you through the exact steps required to complete common admin tasks. Example: “How can I find sites that are potentially over-permissioned?” What to expect: Copilot will recommend clear, sequential instructions to guide you from start to finish. 2. Multi-Criteria Site Search Copilot can help you find sites using multiple conditions at once. Example: “Find sites that have been inactive for more than 60 days and are shared externally.” What to expect: Copilot will generate a filtered list of sites that meet your criteria and suggest recommended actions.

roadmap.title: Access SharePoint agents in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
roadmap.description: Use SharePoint agents seamlessly without navigating to the SharePoint site. With this new feature, you can quickly return to your most recently used SharePoint agents directly in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

roadmap.title: Text Editor Copilot 'Refine' update
roadmap.description: SharePoint is updating the capabilities of its text editor Copilot. Now, you can not only use copilot to rewrite your existing text but also use it to keep writing or add a grounding document. By answering the question "what do you want copilot to change", you can perform any number of refinements to your existing content.

roadmap.title: SharePoint agents in Teams Mobile
roadmap.description: Use SharePoint agents in Teams Mobile group chats and meetings.

roadmap.title: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
roadmap.description: AI citations analytics will help you track the usage of SP documents, news and pages through copilot and AI agents. You will be able to see how often a page or a file is referenced in a copilot response. You can also get insights into SharePoint site content getting referenced in copilot responses aggregated at the site level.

roadmap.title: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
roadmap.description: Users can chat one-on-one with a SharePoint agent directly within Teams chat.

apps.name: Planner
apps.blurb: Create plans, generate tasks and track progress conversationally instead of building boards by hand.
apps.detail: Copilot in Planner builds the plan for you. Describe a project and it generates a task breakdown with sensible buckets and sequencing, then keeps it current — adding tasks, adjusting assignments and answering questions about status without you clicking through the board.
scenarios: Create a plan for a product launch with phases and owners.
What tasks are overdue and who owns them?
Add follow-up tasks from this meeting recap to the existing plan.

links.label: Create a new plan with Copilot in Planner
links.summary: You can use Copilot when you create a plan in Planner.

roadmap.title: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
roadmap.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

roadmap.title: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
roadmap.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

roadmap.title: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
roadmap.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

roadmap.title: Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
roadmap.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

roadmap.title: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
roadmap.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

apps.name: Forms
apps.blurb: Draft surveys, quizzes and polls from a description, then summarize the responses that come back.
apps.detail: Copilot in Forms handles both ends of a survey. Describe what you want to learn and it drafts the questions — with sensible response types and scales — then, once responses arrive, summarizes the themes and sentiment instead of leaving you to read every free-text answer.
scenarios: Create an employee engagement survey covering workload and recognition.
Draft a post-event feedback form with a mix of ratings and open questions.
Summarize the themes in the free-text responses to this survey.

links.label: Welcome to Copilot in Forms
links.summary: Learn about Copilot in Forms and how it helps you create surveys and forms with ease.

roadmap.title: Copilot in Forms - US Government clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments, bringing end-to-end AI assistance to forms, from creating a form, to refining and sending to analyzing results. This rollout includes key Copilot features such as: - Draft with Copilot - Distribution and monitoring - Copilot Insights - On-canvas Copilot features such as Rewrite question, Continue writing, Answer explanations, and more.

apps.name: Viva
apps.blurb: Bring Copilot into employee experience workflows across Viva Engage, Insights, Learning and Glint.
apps.detail: Across the Viva suite, Copilot supports the people side of work: drafting and summarizing community conversations in Engage, interpreting collaboration patterns in Insights, recommending learning paths, and helping admins make sense of survey feedback in Glint.
scenarios: Summarize what my Engage communities discussed this week.
Draft an announcement post for a company-wide policy change.
What are the main themes in our latest engagement survey?

roadmap.title: Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
roadmap.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
roadmap.description:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard at Day Level
roadmap.description: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
roadmap.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
roadmap.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

roadmap.title: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
roadmap.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

roadmap.title: Viva Engage - Agents in communities
roadmap.description: Agents in Viva Engage communities supports communities by answering questions, facilitating knowledge sharing, citing sources, and scaling expertise.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
roadmap.description: Managers in organizations can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 Dashboard in Insights
roadmap.description: Customers can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling leaders to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

roadmap.title: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
roadmap.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher engagement and richer insights from surveys.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
roadmap.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

roadmap.title: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
roadmap.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
roadmap.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Viva Pulse - Capture targeted Copilot sentiment from power and novice users
roadmap.description: Enable change leaders to quickly identify and auto-populate Microsoft 365 Copilot power users and novice users based on organizational attributes and aggregated Copilot usage data. Automatic audience targeting in Viva Pulse will empower change leaders to capture sentiment on Copilot use cases, verbatims, and learnings with insights into whether specific audiences need more training or whether certain pockets of the organization would benefit from receiving upgraded Copilot licenses.

roadmap.title: Viva Pulse - Measure Copilot sentiment to change manage and scale Copilot adoption
roadmap.description: Add new Viva Pulse survey templates for Copilot readiness, adoption, and business value, with built-in entry points and reporting surfaced directly in the Copilot Dashboard. All Copilot templates are fully customizable in Pulse, with the ability to add or edit questions using Copilot authoring and the question library. Organizations can also easily upload pilot group users into Pulse via CSV to target surveys at the right audiences from day one.

roadmap.title: Viva Pulse - Authoring with M365 Copilot
roadmap.description: Viva Pulse authors can now work with M365 Copilot to add a question, rewrite a question, and create a survey from scratch to quickly create and send their surveys to their teams to collect feedback. M365 Copilot can seamlessly capture the author's needs to recommend survey questions that fit their unique scenario. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Copilot Analytics - Highlights on Copilot adoption from Viva Engage
roadmap.description: Explore how Copilot is making a difference in your organization through Viva Engage posts that users have shared. The Copilot Dashboard showcases real-world success stories, user-shared excitement about new Copilot features, and vibrant community discussions. These examples offer a qualitative view into how Copilot is driving productivity and engagement across your tenant, directly in the Copilot Dashboard. #CopilotControlSystem

roadmap.title: SharePoint agent analytics on Viva Insights
roadmap.description: Explore how your employees used key SharePoint agent features over a given time period and understand the ROI. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Copilot Dashboard - Enhanced scope drilldown
roadmap.description: Leaders and managers can drilldown and explore data in Copilot Dashboard by indirect groups, unlocking a new layer of visibility into Copilot adoption and impact. #copilotcontrolsystem

roadmap.title: Viva Learning - Copilot Academy reports in Viva Insights
roadmap.description: Usage reporting for Copilot Academy will be available in Viva Insights via the Analyst Workbench. Users can access these reports through Excel or a PowerBI dashboard.

roadmap.title: Copilot Dashboard Trendline Additions
roadmap.description: Copilot Dashboard users can now visualize trends in additional key adoption and impact metrics over time to more quickly identify patterns and opportunities in employee adoption for better licensing decisions. Users will be able to now view Adoption metrics on either a monthly or weekly timeframe for specific groups of interest, as well as deep dive into Impact metrics like Copilot Assisted Hours, Actions Taken, and feature-specific dimensions.

roadmap.title: Search Skill (Copilot in Engage)
roadmap.description: Engage Copilot now uses search skills to find and summarize relevant posts, with citations and direct links.

roadmap.title: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
roadmap.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

roadmap.title: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
roadmap.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

roadmap.title: Viva Insights - Skills landscape report for organizations
roadmap.description: A Power BI report that provides an overview of the skills distribution in the organization and supports users in identifying skill gaps and making informed decisions on workforce planning, resource allocation, and skilling initiatives.

blogs.title: Engage customers with Teams Phone Agent and custom voice agents built in Copilot Studio
blogs.description: It’s often difficult for businesses to serve every customer right away during surges in call volumes. Callers sit on hold while staff race to work through the backlog. Meanwhile, agentic voice AI is opening entirely new ways to serve customers, such as getting

apps.name: Clipchamp
apps.blurb: Summarize and ask questions about video content directly in the Clipchamp player.
apps.detail: Copilot in the Clipchamp player makes video searchable. Rather than scrubbing through a recording, you can ask what was covered, get a summary of the main points, and jump to the moment a specific topic came up.
scenarios: Summarize the main points covered in this recording.
Where in this video does the speaker discuss pricing?
List the questions asked during this recorded session.

links.label: Ask questions & summarize video with Copilot
links.summary: Learn how Copilot in Microsoft Clipchamp can help you get more value from videos in your organization. Discover how to summarize videos, ask questions, locate key information, and more.

apps.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
apps.blurb: The central Copilot surface — chat grounded in your work data, with agents, Pages and file creation.
apps.detail: Copilot Chat is the hub the rest of the experience hangs off. It answers questions grounded in your emails, files, meetings and chats, hosts the first-party agents, creates Word, Excel and PowerPoint files on request, and turns any answer into a shareable Copilot Page your team can build on.
scenarios: What did my team decide about the migration timeline?
