links.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot help and learning
links.summary: Learn how to use Microsoft Copilot, your AI-first productivity assistant across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and more.

links.label: Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot scenarios
links.summary: Discover how to configure Microsoft Copilot scenarios in the admin center. Streamline user access, data security, and Copilot actions for your team.

roadmap.title: Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
roadmap.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

roadmap.title: Copilot in SharePoint
roadmap.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

roadmap.title: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business in your open OneDrive and SharePoint documents
roadmap.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open cloud documents in Copilot Chat in Edge.

roadmap.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
roadmap.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

roadmap.title: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
roadmap.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

roadmap.title: Skills in Brand Kit
roadmap.description: Upload skill (.md file) in Brand Kit and use within PPT Copilot

roadmap.title: Local inferencing
roadmap.description:
Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.

Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response.

roadmap.title: Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
roadmap.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable connectors that don't meet their organization's policies.

roadmap.title: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
roadmap.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

roadmap.title: Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

roadmap.title: Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

roadmap.title: Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
roadmap.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

roadmap.title: Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
roadmap.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

roadmap.title: Meeting Shared Files
roadmap.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

roadmap.title: Ask Copilot about an image
roadmap.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

roadmap.title: Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
roadmap.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

roadmap.title: Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

roadmap.title: Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
roadmap.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

roadmap.title: Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
roadmap.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

roadmap.title: Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
roadmap.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

roadmap.title: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
roadmap.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

roadmap.title: New Rich Answer Cards
roadmap.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

roadmap.title: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
roadmap.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

roadmap.title: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
roadmap.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

roadmap.title: Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
roadmap.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

blogs.title: What’s New in Microsoft 365 Copilot | July 2026
blogs.description: Welcome to the July 2026 edition of What's New in Microsoft 365 Copilot! Every month, we highlight new features and enhancements to keep Microsoft 365 customers up to date with Copilot features that help your users be more productive and efficient in the apps
